about_short_description.short_description: Lottie is to empower care seekers and to lead the global transformation to modern and sustainable care.

product.name: Lottie Online Marketplace
product.description: An online platform listing over 4,000 vetted care homes, home care, and retirement living options across the UK for care seekers to browse and find suitable care providers.

product.name: Lottie Care Support Service
product.description: A free expert consultation service providing guidance on finding, funding, and navigating care options for individuals and families seeking care solutions.

product.name: Seniorcare by Lottie
product.description: An eldercare employee benefit solution that supports employees in understanding, finding, and funding care for elderly dependents through technology and expert care guidance.

product.name: Found CRM
product.description: A cloud-based customer relationship management software tailored for care providers to manage enquiries, occupancy, marketing, and billing operations.

product.name: Lottie Partner Services
product.description: Additional services offered to care and retirement providers including data services, professional photography, virtual tours, and marketing support to enhance their online presence.
